Author: ocealot
Name: JobBars
Description:
Additional job gauges, party buff timers, mitigation trackers, and more. Icon by PAPACHIN

Fork of 0ceal0t/JobBars: hovering an icon on the Buffs or Cooldowns bar now shows the game's own action tooltip. Toggle per bar in /jobbars.
Punchline: Extra job gauges (fork: native action tooltips on hover)
Changelog: Adds native action tooltips when hovering Buffs / Cooldowns icons, via KamiToolKit's NodeBase.ActionTooltip. Toggle per bar in /jobbars (default on). Registering a tooltip adds NodeFlags.HasCollision, so the icons capture the mouse.
